verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a REST API with reference pages (e.g. /reference/webhooks.md), a published openapi.json, and a quickstart for making a first API request. None of it documents an interactive reference or runnable in-browser examples. A machine-readable OpenAPI spec and a quickstart guide are building blocks, not the interactive explorer the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
